# dxf-output

The catalog of DXF layers (`epc_dxf.layers`): a drawing asks for a layer by its role (`sld.diagram`, `plan.ELEC-LUM`...) and the catalog says what it is called and how it looks.
The default catalog travels with the package; the global file the MASTER edits (console, Capas de dibujo) overrides it role by role.
